_comment: Default settings sketch for SNAPter. Only the 'ui' section is read by the stub. User choices are saved to config\settings.json (created on first change), defaults stay untouched.

modifiers._comment: Master switches for Shift / Ctrl / Alt. enabled: everything on or off. while_drawing: the held key acts while a region or shape is drawn. tap: a plain tap acts on the region or the selected object. for_region / for_shapes: which targets. shown_actions: which choices the settings list shows (the others are hidden to keep the list clean).

after._comment: What happens after a capture. copy_and_save: saving also copies to the clipboard. open_folder: show the saved file in Explorer. fullscreen_in_editor: 'whole screen' opens the editor with the monitor selected.

editor._comment: preset_count 2-9 (keys 1-9). shared_color: one color for all tools. step_style: number | upper | lower | roman. arrow_head: triangle | open | dot.

editor_keys._comment: One key per tool (a letter, a digit or F1-F12). Presets are preset1..preset9.

ratio._comment: key: the key that switches the aspect ratio of the region (with Shift: back). Any key name (Tab, Oem3, F2, Q...) or none. list: see the page 'Aspect ratios' of the settings (when it is absent the program's own list is used).

profile_cycle._comment: In the editor (before, while and after drawing the region) the key switches the profiles one by one, for this capture only. key: the name of a key (Oem3 = the key left of 1: Yo on a Russian keyboard, ` or ~ on an English one; Tab, F2, Q, ...) or none. order: the profiles separated by commas (full, ascetic, minimal and your own); empty = the standard order, a capture starts with the saved setup. When the order is set on the settings page the first profile of it is used when a region is started.

overlay._comment: Region selection stays minimal and does not depend on theme (dim + frame + size label).

enter_actions._comment: What Enter does in the editor, by the held key: none (Enter alone), shift, ctrl, alt, ctrl+shift... Actions: save (no dialog), save_as (dialog), pin, copy, upload, close, none. Ctrl+C always copies.

snap._comment: Hold the key while dragging an object (or placing a numbered step): it sticks to the vertical or horizontal axis of another object when it is closer than threshold_px; drag further and it comes off. key: right_alt | right_ctrl | right_shift | left_alt | left_ctrl | left_shift.

record._comment: Recording of the screen. folder: empty = the screenshots folder. show_frame: a frame with a timer and a Stop button around the recorded area. gif: a built-in encoder. video: FFmpeg (ffmpeg_path empty = look in PATH and the usual folders).

scroll._comment: Scrolling screenshot: the program scrolls the area with the mouse wheel, takes the pieces and joins them. delay_ms: pause after each scroll. wheel_notches: how far one scroll goes. skip_top_px / skip_bottom_px: fixed header and footer of the page that do not scroll. tolerance_pct: how many rows of the overlap may differ.

capture._comment: delay_seconds: pause for 'region after a delay'. window_snap: a plain click on a window selects the whole window.

upload._comment: target: none | folder | gdrive. folder: a normal folder, for example the one that Google Drive for desktop synchronizes. gdrive: Google Drive API (create an OAuth client of type Desktop app in Google Cloud Console, enable Google Drive API, paste client_id and client_secret in the USER file config\settings.json - never in a public repository). The program sees only the folder and files it created itself (scope drive.file).

text._comment: neural_safe: a plate under text is drawn as an outline instead (a plate can be mistaken for an interface element by a neural network).

modifier_actions._comment: What the held Shift / Ctrl / Alt combination does while drawing or selecting a region. Actions, comma separated: constrain (square, circle, 45 degree lines), center (draw from the center), rounded (rounded rectangle), axis (horizontal or vertical only), double (arrow with two heads), fill (toggle fill), none.

beautify._comment: Beautiful screenshot: the finished picture is put on a background with space around it, rounded corners and a shadow. enabled = on for every capture (the Beautiful button or Ctrl+B in the editor switches it for one capture). background: gradient | solid | transparent. preset: ocean | sunset | forest | graphite | paper | custom (custom uses color1 and color2).

layout._fit_comment: When the region is big and the panels do not fit outside it: fit_enabled turns the adaptive layout on; fit_shrink lets the panels shrink down to fit_min_scale percent; fit_hide hides the groups listed in fit_hide_items (recent, presets, colors, shape, sliders, extra, actions2) when it is still too tight; fit_fallback = inside (panels go inside the region, corner_key moves them from corner to corner) or clamp (the old behaviour). props_layout: groups of the bottom panel (presets, colors, recent, shape, sliders, extra, actions, actions2, close), a vertical bar starts a new line; the program merges lines or wraps them as needed. corner_key: Shift+Tab | CapsLock | Tab | F1 | none. start_corner: bottom_right | bottom_left | top_left | top_right.

output._comment_format: format: png | jpg | webp | bmp. fullscreen_format: same | png | jpg | webp | bmp (the format of 'whole screen to file'). Quality: jpg_quality 10-100, webp_quality 1-100, webp_lossless true/false.
